titles.title: A resolution expressing concern about the increasing influence of the People's Republic of China in Latin America and the Caribbean and calling for strengthened United States economic, security, and diplomatic engagement in the region.

A resolution expressing concern about the increasing influence of the People's Republic of China in Latin America and the Caribbean and calling for strengthened United States economic, security, and diplomatic engagement in the region.

action.text: Referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations.

bill.summary: This resolution expresses commitment to countering the influence of China in Latin America and the Caribbean and emphasizes the importance of U.S. investment and engagement in the region. The resolution also encourages countries in Latin America and the Caribbean to review foreign investments in strategic sectors that risk undermining their security.
